{{Quote|Sir, with the death of Senator Kharrus, are you now in command of the mission?|Clone trooper to [[Stone (clone trooper)/Legends|Stone]]|audio=FlorrumTrooper-TGG.flac|<ref name="The Gungan General">{{TCW|The Gungan General}}</ref>}}
A '''clone''' who served as a [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|shock trooper]] with the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] accompanied [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Stone (clone trooper)/Legends|Stone]] and several other troopers of the [[Diplomatic Escort Group]] with [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Kharrus/Legends|Kharrus]] and [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] to [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]]. He survived the crash of their [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] and with the death of Kharrus, was skeptical about Binks's ability to lead the group. He along with all other clones survived the mission and departed Florrum aboard the [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']].
